rfqRoute: Paper box, cardboard stock and carton box searches need a structure-first RFQ route, not a generic price request.
Buyers should clarify whether they need folding cartons, rigid paper boxes, corrugated mailer boxes, gift boxes, inserts, sleeves or retail cartons.

A useful paper packaging RFQ should include product dimensions, product weight, board direction, box structure, print coverage, finish, insert/protection needs, quantity range, artwork status and sales channel.
For high-impression low-click terms such as cardboard or boxes, MUGE should use clearer page language and social explanations that separate raw material search from custom packaging project review.
This route connects broad paper-box searches to official quote checklist, product overview and contact pages for project-specific review.
